taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Cross-site scripting: reflected, stored and DOM â€” authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace a controlled value from storage/URL/message through transformations to its final DOM/template context. Record origin, browser, CSP/Trusted Types enforcement, victim role and who can deliver the value.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an inert local browser marker at the actual consumer, with no data exfiltration. Compare text rendering against HTML/attribute/URL/JS interpretation as applicable. For stored content, use a separate controlled viewer to establish reach beyond the submitting account. Inspect parsed DOM and execution, not only the original response text.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Escaped reflection and markup assigned as text to an ordinary text-bearing element are not XSS. A script/style consumer or later reparse requires its own interpretation review; the API name alone is not a universal safety guarantee. A dangerous-looking sink may receive only trusted constants. Self-only behavior and CSP-blocked execution need their real prerequisites and supported impact, not an invented account takeover.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use a safe consumer or context-appropriate encoding/sanitization for the required rich-content contract. Test the original data flow, legitimate formatting and one alternate transformation evidenced in source.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
